title: AI-driven multi-omics biomarkers in precision breast cancer therapeutics: from discovery to clinical translation.

title: Comprehensive metabolomic characterization of patients with myasthenia gravis.
snippet: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is mediated by abnormal antibody generation and is characterized by muscle weakness and pathological fatigue.
